author: Unknown; carved on a stone near a burial mound
pages:
#Lament at the Barrow Gate

~Here lie the bold who held the line
~when the sky was black with wings;
~they gave their breath, their blood, their names,
~and asked for no such things.

~Speak softly as you pass this door,
~and do not break the seal:
~the dead who sleep behind it here
~were faithful, and are real.

~Their oaths were sworn to bronze and bone,
~their watch will never cease;
~they wait for those who broke the stone
~and those who'd break the peace.

~So leave your torch, and leave your blade,
~and leave your greed behind;
~for what lies here was never made
~for the eyes of living kind.

#Added Below, in a Different Hand

We did not listen. Two of us went in. One came out.

Do not go in.
